results.title: Work Life Panda: Every task, every calendar, one app. ...
results.content:
Underneath it's a real task manager, and the AI that turns a sentence or your voice into a task runs on your device. Small local models, no cloud round-trip for the everyday stuff. "Private by default" isn't a tagline here.  
  
And then the bit nobody expects: every task and event carries its own chat, files and history. Share one into a private Family, Group or Work space and the conversation about a thing lives on the thing, instead of scrolling away in a group chat.  
  
It's early access and completely free while I build. No ads, no purchases yet. I'd genuinely love brutal feedback: what clicks, what's missing, and, if you'd ever pay for something like this, what would make it worth it. I'm in the comments all day. 🐼

### Top forum threads [...] 👋 Hey Product Hunt, I'm Andrea, the maker behind Work Life Panda.  
  
My week lived in a calendar, my to-dos in a list, and every plan involving another person in a group chat: three apps, none of which talked to each other. So I built the merge: a real task manager and a real calendar that are the same thing.  
  
And it starts full. Sign in with one tap, connect the calendar you already use (Google, Apple, Outlook or others) and your actual week is just there: still your calendar, not a copy, so a change in either place is a change in both. Connect a mailbox and the invitations already sitting in it quietly become events. Nothing to import, nothing to retype.
